_comment: The GLM-5.3-Flash providers aidev-evolve uses on the HF router (packaged; providers.py reads it). Each attendee's first provider comes from a weighted rendezvous hash of the lowercased HF username; the others, in the same order, are the fallback. Load test of 2026-11-25 (256 agent-like conversations per provider at once): together, coreweave, deepinfra and wafer had no 429/5xx (weight 2); particle-ai had sporadic failures at low load (weight 1). Left out: baseten (clean at 64 conversations only), zai-org and novita (HTTP 400 'not supported by provider'). A listed provider that starts refusing is left out for the rest of an evaluation Job (providers.Pool.refuse). Change the list here only.
